message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: multiple instances of fraud via online platforms, using false pretenses to obtain money. Likely "诈骗罪" (fraud). Also possibly "非法获取金融账户信息"? But the facts: He posted false purchase offers, induced victims to transfer money via Alipay, WeChat Pay, online banking. That's typical fraud (诈骗). Could also be "非法获取公民个人信息罪"? Not indicated. So only fraud.

In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "诈骗罪". If multiple victims, still same crime. Could also be "非法经营罪"? No. So answer: 诈骗罪.

Thus format: [诈骗罪]<eoa> but need [罪名] and <eoa>. Example: [诈骗罪]<eoa>.
